title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-05-31 Deligne working record: corrected Weil II plus Illusie III letter
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing. The first PDFs are cumulative working readers for the Deligne papers touched so far: one English translation reader and one French source/working-LaTeX reader. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and a separate Deligne-to-Illusie III (1976) letter are also exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [######----] active touched-paper stream: 14 paper-level English working translations are in the current cumulative reader; [#---------] correspondence stream: one Deligne-to-Illusie III letter is available in English and French working PDFs; [###-------] French source or working-LaTeX top-level readers are present for Papers 32, 84, and 85, with broader original/reference material preserved in ZIP artifacts; [##########] original/reference and provenance material is preserved. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Paper 32 now uses the corrected complete source-grounded package. The Deligne-to-Illusie III (1976) letter has been added as a separate front-facing item, with its source scan and TeX files preserved in the artifacts.

Workflow provenance: public scans and source witnesses are converted into TeX, checked and organized locally, then packaged here with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, and reuse the work. The public organization is by paper, correspondence item, and work status.
notes: Latest update promotes the corrected complete Paper 32 Weil II package and adds the Deligne-to-Illusie III (1976) letter as a separate reader-facing item.
